turn_dispatch_rejected.title: The provider did not produce a completed answer
turn_dispatch_rejected.description: The runner did not receive a usable completed response from the provider.
turn_dispatch_rejected.recovery: Inspect the existing run and provider connection before starting another request. A failed response does not establish that no remote work occurred.

completed_without_agent_message.title: The provider did not produce a completed answer
completed_without_agent_message.description: The runner did not receive a usable completed response from the provider.
completed_without_agent_message.recovery: Inspect the existing run and provider connection before starting another request. A failed response does not establish that no remote work occurred.

local_runner_url_required.title: The Runner URL is invalid
local_runner_url_required.description: The runner address must use an allowed local HTTP endpoint without embedded credentials.
local_runner_url_required.recovery: Open Advanced controls and correct Runner URL using the address provided by the local runner operator. Do not include credentials in the URL.

local_bridge_url_required.title: The service address is not supported
local_bridge_url_required.description: This deployment requires an approved local service address.
local_bridge_url_required.recovery: Ask the deployment owner to check the local runner or backend bridge configuration. Do not include credentials in the address.

skill_edit_no_change.title: No changes were needed
skill_edit_no_change.description: The proposed files are identical to the selected Skill revision.
skill_edit_no_change.recovery: Review the current files and update the Edit Request if a different change is intended. An unchanged proposal does not create a new revision.

timeout_must_be_1_to_240_seconds.title: The HTTP timeout is outside its allowed range
timeout_must_be_1_to_240_seconds.description: The node rejected its timeout setting before dispatch.
timeout_must_be_1_to_240_seconds.recovery: Open Advanced controls and set HTTP Timeout to a value from 1 to 240 seconds, then run the corrected request.

invalid_operation.title: The operation is not supported
invalid_operation.description: The node rejected the selected operation before dispatch.
invalid_operation.recovery: Choose a supported operation from the Operation dropdown and review its required inputs.

invalid_request_id.title: The request identifier is invalid
invalid_request_id.description: The execution request has an invalid UUID. Current node runs assign request IDs automatically.
invalid_request_id.recovery: If this comes from an API request, correct its request identifier. For a node-generated request, share the safe details with the application maintainer and inspect any existing request before dispatching another.

invalid_output_retry_count.title: The continuation retry count is invalid
invalid_output_retry_count.description: The node rejected the configured output continuation allowance.
invalid_output_retry_count.recovery: Open Advanced controls and set Output Continuation Retries to a supported nonnegative count within the node limits.

invalid_static_output_requirements.title: The output requirements are invalid or conflict
invalid_static_output_requirements.description: The saved output requirements could not be validated consistently.
invalid_static_output_requirements.recovery: Review the downstream Output Contract and remove conflicting legacy requirements in the saved flow or API request. Do not change the contract of an existing run.

conflicting_output_requirements.title: The output requirements are invalid or conflict
conflicting_output_requirements.description: The saved output requirements could not be validated consistently.
conflicting_output_requirements.recovery: Review the downstream Output Contract and remove conflicting legacy requirements in the saved flow or API request. Do not change the contract of an existing run.

output_requirements_require_fresh_start.title: This configuration requires a new session
output_requirements_require_fresh_start.description: The selected operation cannot use these start-only requirements or handoff settings.
output_requirements_require_fresh_start.recovery: Use Fresh or Start for start-only requirements. To continue an existing run, preserve its original configuration and remove incompatible start-only overrides.

join_bridge_requires_fresh_start.title: This configuration requires a new session
join_bridge_requires_fresh_start.description: The selected operation cannot use these start-only requirements or handoff settings.
join_bridge_requires_fresh_start.recovery: Use Fresh or Start for start-only requirements. To continue an existing run, preserve its original configuration and remove incompatible start-only overrides.

handoff_requires_fresh_operation.title: This configuration requires a new session
handoff_requires_fresh_operation.description: The selected operation cannot use these start-only requirements or handoff settings.
handoff_requires_fresh_operation.recovery: Use Fresh or Start for start-only requirements. To continue an existing run, preserve its original configuration and remove incompatible start-only overrides.

invalid_handoff_reference.title: The handoff reference is invalid
invalid_handoff_reference.description: The supplied handoff record is malformed or incomplete.
invalid_handoff_reference.recovery: Restore the original handoff record from its producing node or saved request. Do not invent execution identifiers.

join_bridge_execution_identity_unavailab.title: The execution identity is unavailable
join_bridge_execution_identity_unavailab.description: The application could not obtain the execution identity needed for mediated dispatch.
join_bridge_execution_identity_unavailab.recovery: Ask the application operator to inspect this graph execution and its bridge configuration before submitting another request.

stop_runner_http_error.title: Cancellation could not be confirmed
stop_runner_http_error.description: The runner rejected the cancellation check or returned an unreadable response. The remote run may still be active.
stop_runner_http_error.recovery: Ask the operator to query the original run and confirm its outcome before starting another request. A local Stop is not proof of remote cancellation.

stop_runner_invalid_response.title: Cancellation could not be confirmed
stop_runner_invalid_response.description: The runner rejected the cancellation check or returned an unreadable response. The remote run may still be active.
stop_runner_invalid_response.recovery: Ask the operator to query the original run and confirm its outcome before starting another request. A local Stop is not proof of remote cancellation.

catalog_too_large.title: The runner model catalogue could not be read
catalog_too_large.description: The returned model catalogue is empty, invalid or exceeds the supported size.
catalog_too_large.recovery: Check the local runner connection and ask the operator to restore its model catalogue. Do not guess provider model identifiers.

invalid_catalog.title: The runner model catalogue could not be read
invalid_catalog.description: The returned model catalogue is empty, invalid or exceeds the supported size.
invalid_catalog.recovery: Check the local runner connection and ask the operator to restore its model catalogue. Do not guess provider model identifiers.

empty_catalog.title: The runner model catalogue could not be read
empty_catalog.description: The returned model catalogue is empty, invalid or exceeds the supported size.
empty_catalog.recovery: Check the local runner connection and ask the operator to restore its model catalogue. Do not guess provider model identifiers.

catalog_provider_mismatch.title: The model list belongs to another runner
catalog_provider_mismatch.description: The configured endpoint did not identify itself as the Claude runner.
catalog_provider_mismatch.recovery: Check Runner URL in Advanced controls and select the Claude runner service, then refresh Model. Refresh does not submit a model turn.

unsupported_claude_effort.title: This Claude model does not support that effort
unsupported_claude_effort.description: The selected reasoning effort is not supported by the current Claude model or adapter.
unsupported_claude_effort.recovery: Refresh Model, select the intended model, and choose one of its listed Reasoning Effort values. Models without effort support use Default automatically.

claude_model_required.title: Choose an available Claude model
claude_model_required.description: The requested model is missing, invalid or absent from the current Claude Code model picker.
claude_model_required.recovery: Refresh Model and select a listed Claude model. If the list cannot be loaded, check Runner URL and the runner service before submitting work.

unsupported_claude_cli_version.title: The Claude runner image has an unsupported CLI
unsupported_claude_cli_version.description: The CLI inside the configured Docker image does not match the version supported by this runner.
unsupported_claude_cli_version.recovery: Rebuild the pinned docker/claude image and restart the runner. Updating the VS Code extension does not update this image.

claude_subscription_override_refused.title: Claude subscription mode is not configured safely
claude_subscription_override_refused.description: A provider or credential override could route this subscription-backed runner through a different account or billing method.
claude_subscription_override_refused.recovery: Ask the operator to remove conflicting provider overrides from the dedicated runner environment and use the existing Claude Code subscription login. Never paste credentials into the graph.

claude_subscription_unavailable.title: The dedicated Claude runner is not signed in
claude_subscription_unavailable.description: The isolated Docker profile has no usable Claude subscription login. Your personal host login is not used.
claude_subscription_unavailable.recovery: Sign into the dedicated container profile using the documented login command, then refresh Model. Keep API billing overrides unset.

claude_proposal_scope_only.title: This Claude node can only propose changes
claude_proposal_scope_only.description: The request included a direct GitHub authorization or execution handoff that this proposal adapter does not support.
claude_proposal_scope_only.recovery: Send the proposed answer to the authorized Skill or GitHub Operation input. Remove direct execution or GitHub authorization from the Claude request.

claude_prompt_too_large.title: The Claude input is too large
claude_prompt_too_large.description: The task and pinned skill context exceed this adapter's supported prompt size.
claude_prompt_too_large.recovery: Reduce the task or pinned skill context before submitting work. Keep the intended skill revision and operation authorization explicit.

claude_receipt_too_large.title: The Claude response exceeded the capture limit
claude_receipt_too_large.description: The runner could not safely capture the complete native response, so it cannot confirm a usable result.
claude_receipt_too_large.recovery: Check the existing run and ask the operator to inspect its retained evidence before starting another request. Do not assume a replacement turn is necessary or authorized.

claude_terminal_receipt_invalid.title: The Claude completion receipt could not be read
claude_terminal_receipt_invalid.description: The native response did not contain a valid completion receipt for this adapter.
claude_terminal_receipt_invalid.recovery: Check the existing run and ask the operator to inspect its retained evidence before starting another request. Do not treat an unreadable receipt as a confirmed failed execution.

claude_session_identity_mismatch.title: The Claude response belongs to a different session
claude_session_identity_mismatch.description: The native completion receipt did not match the session bound to this run.
claude_session_identity_mismatch.recovery: Keep the original run reference and ask the operator to reconcile the retained session evidence before starting another request. Do not substitute session identifiers.

claude_native_turn_failed.title: Claude did not return a successful turn
claude_native_turn_failed.description: The native Claude receipt reported an unsuccessful result. The underlying cause is not established by this code.
claude_native_turn_failed.recovery: Check the existing run and its recorded diagnostics with the operator before starting another request. Confirm subscription availability and the remaining allowance without assuming either caused the failure.

claude_native_turn_limit_mismatch.title: Claude exceeded the expected turn boundary
claude_native_turn_limit_mismatch.description: The native receipt did not match the adapter's single-turn and no-subagent boundary.
claude_native_turn_limit_mismatch.recovery: Ask the operator to reconcile the existing run, session and allowance evidence before starting another request. Do not increase the allowance to bypass this check.

claude_process_failed.title: The Claude process did not finish successfully
claude_process_failed.description: The native process ended without a confirmed successful receipt. This code does not establish the underlying cause.
claude_process_failed.recovery: Check the existing run and ask the operator to inspect its retained diagnostics before starting another request. Do not repeat work whose outcome is uncertain.

claude_parent_stop_unverified.title: Claude process shutdown could not be confirmed
claude_parent_stop_unverified.description: The runner could not confirm that the native parent process stopped.
claude_parent_stop_unverified.recovery: Ask the operator to inspect the existing process and run state before starting another request. Do not assume cancellation or timeout stopped all activity.

claude_turn_timeout.title: Claude reached the execution deadline
claude_turn_timeout.description: The invocation exceeded its Execution Timeout, including output corrections. Cleanup is checked before the run finishes.
claude_turn_timeout.recovery: Inspect partial activity and cleanup status. If cleanup is verified, adjust Execution Timeout in Advanced before starting a replacement task.

claude_cancelled.title: The Claude operation was cancelled
claude_cancelled.description: Cancellation was requested and no successful answer is available from this attempt.
claude_cancelled.recovery: Check the existing run to confirm its final state before starting another request. Keep any retained answer or operation evidence until the outcome is reconciled.

pinned_skill_workspace_changed.title: The pinned Claude skill context changed
pinned_skill_workspace_changed.description: The staged skill files no longer match the revision pinned to this run.
pinned_skill_workspace_changed.recovery: Ask the operator to inspect the retained workspace and restore a verified skill revision. Check the existing run before starting replacement work.

activity_attempt_already_exists.title: Activity capture already exists for this attempt
activity_attempt_already_exists.description: The runner refused to replace an existing activity boundary for this attempt.
activity_attempt_already_exists.recovery: Inspect the existing run in Agents and ask the operator to reconcile its activity evidence before starting another request. Do not reset the allowance or overwrite the existing attempt.

run_not_active_in_this_process.title: This runner cannot stop the existing process
run_not_active_in_this_process.description: The run is not owned as an active process by this runner instance.
run_not_active_in_this_process.recovery: Check the existing run and ask the operator to inspect the original runner process before starting another request. Do not interpret this refusal as confirmed cancellation.

run_not_dispatchable.title: This run cannot be started in its current state
run_not_dispatchable.description: The existing run is no longer in a state that accepts dispatch.
run_not_dispatchable.recovery: Inspect the existing run and recorded activity before starting another request. Use its current lifecycle state rather than repeating the original dispatch.

empty_token.title: The runner credential is empty
empty_token.description: The local runner credential file contains no usable token.
empty_token.recovery: Ask the operator to restore the configured runner credential file. Do not paste credentials into the graph.

conflicting_skill_inputs.title: Conflicting Skill Reference fields
conflicting_skill_inputs.description: The request supplied both a single reference and a list of references.
conflicting_skill_inputs.recovery: Use only the Agent Skill References input, or leave it disconnected. Share Technical details with the maintainer if this persists.

invalid_request.title: The Agent request could not be read
invalid_request.description: The runner received an invalid request structure.
invalid_request.recovery: Share the safe Technical details with the application maintainer. Check the existing run before starting another request.

materialized_skill_mismatch.title: A pinned skill changed in the workspace
materialized_skill_mismatch.description: The run-local skill files do not match their recorded revision.
materialized_skill_mismatch.recovery: Do not resume this workspace. Ask the runner operator to inspect the pinned skill snapshot and review the existing run.

skill_file_hash_mismatch.title: A pinned skill file could not be verified
skill_file_hash_mismatch.description: A file in the selected skill revision does not match its recorded hash.
skill_file_hash_mismatch.recovery: Choose a valid registered revision on the connected Skill node or ask the registry operator to inspect it.

skill_frontmatter_name_mismatch.title: The skill name does not match its reference
skill_frontmatter_name_mismatch.description: The selected skill declares a different name from its registry identity.
skill_frontmatter_name_mismatch.recovery: Correct the skill name in the registry and select the new immutable revision on the Skill node.

skill_frontmatter_name_required.title: The selected skill needs a valid name
skill_frontmatter_name_required.description: The pinned skill lacks a readable SKILL.md with a valid frontmatter name.
skill_frontmatter_name_required.recovery: Correct SKILL.md in the registry and select the new revision, or disconnect the optional skill.

skill_path_conflict.title: A skill path already exists in the workspace
skill_path_conflict.description: The source snapshot already contains the path reserved for a connected skill.
skill_path_conflict.recovery: Ask the runner operator to remove the conflicting skill directory from the source snapshot, then review the selected Skill References.

skill_ref_hash_mismatch.title: The skill revision could not be verified
skill_ref_hash_mismatch.description: The Skill Reference revision and its recorded tree hash disagree.
skill_ref_hash_mismatch.recovery: Select the immutable revision again on the Skill node. Ask the registry operator to inspect it if the mismatch persists.

source_changed_during_snapshot.title: The source changed while being copied
source_changed_during_snapshot.description: The runner could not create matching immutable source snapshots.
source_changed_during_snapshot.recovery: Ask the runner operator to stabilize the configured source before starting another request.

github_scope_must_come_from_authority.title: The GitHub authorization was not accepted
github_scope_must_come_from_authority.description: GitHub access must come from the trusted host authorization flow.
github_scope_must_come_from_authority.recovery: Use the authorized GitHub integration and ask the runner operator to inspect the safe Technical details.

mediated_lease_required.title: This runner cannot provide the requested GitHub access
mediated_lease_required.description: The selected runner does not have the required mediated GitHub execution configuration.
mediated_lease_required.recovery: Ask the runner operator to configure the supported GitHub execution mode. Check the existing run before starting another request.

pinned_skill_record_invalid.title: The saved skill selection is invalid
pinned_skill_record_invalid.description: The run contains an invalid or incomplete skill list. An empty list is valid for a run without skills.
pinned_skill_record_invalid.recovery: Keep the original run record and ask the runner operator to inspect it. Do not change the recorded skill selection to resume.

external_git_directory_unsupported.title: The workspace Git metadata is unsupported
external_git_directory_unsupported.description: The runner requires an independent Git directory inside its workspace.
external_git_directory_unsupported.recovery: Ask the runner operator to provide a source snapshot with supported independent Git metadata.

invalid_skill_id.title: A connected skill has an invalid identifier
invalid_skill_id.description: A supplied skill identifier does not match the supported registry format.
invalid_skill_id.recovery: Select the skill through a Skill node, or disconnect the optional Skill Reference.

skill_git_exclusion_changed.title: The protected skill Git exclusions changed
skill_git_exclusion_changed.description: The workspace no longer has the recorded Git exclusions for its pinned skills.
skill_git_exclusion_changed.recovery: Do not resume this workspace. Ask the runner operator to inspect the existing run and protected Git metadata.

unexpected_materialized_skill.title: The workspace contains an unselected skill
unexpected_materialized_skill.description: The workspace skill directories differ from the explicitly selected skill list. A run without skills requires an empty skill directory.
unexpected_materialized_skill.recovery: Ask the runner operator to remove unintended skills from the source snapshot. Connect a Skill Reference only for skills you intend to include.

unsafe_git_metadata.title: The workspace Git metadata is unsafe
unsafe_git_metadata.description: The runner found linked or unsupported files in its Git metadata.
unsafe_git_metadata.recovery: Ask the runner operator to create a safe independent source snapshot. Do not resume the affected workspace.

unsafe_materialized_skill_path.title: The workspace skill directory is unsafe
unsafe_materialized_skill_path.description: The runner could not verify its isolated skill directory.
unsafe_materialized_skill_path.recovery: Ask the runner operator to inspect the workspace paths. Do not resume the affected workspace.

claude_container_unavailable.title: The Claude container could not be reached
claude_container_unavailable.description: Docker did not complete the requested container operation.
claude_container_unavailable.recovery: Start Docker Desktop, check the configured runner image, then use Start runner. Inspect any existing run before starting another task.

claude_container_configuration_invalid.title: The Claude container configuration is invalid
claude_container_configuration_invalid.description: The host runner image or dedicated profile volume is not configured correctly.
claude_container_configuration_invalid.recovery: Ask the operator to correct the Docker image and dedicated Claude profile volume in the runner service configuration.

claude_container_image_missing.title: The Claude runner image is missing
claude_container_image_missing.description: Docker could not find the configured pinned Claude image.
claude_container_image_missing.recovery: Build the image using docker/claude/Dockerfile as documented, then use Start runner.

claude_container_profile_unavailable.title: The dedicated Claude profile is unavailable
claude_container_profile_unavailable.description: The configured Docker volume could not be created or was not marked as a Claude runner profile.
claude_container_profile_unavailable.recovery: Ask the operator to provision a dedicated Laomedo Claude profile volume. Do not mount your personal profile.

claude_turn_timeout_invalid.title: The execution timeout is invalid
claude_turn_timeout_invalid.description: The execution deadline must be a whole number between 1 and 86400 seconds.
claude_turn_timeout_invalid.recovery: Set Execution Timeout in the node Advanced settings to a supported value.

claude_workspace_command_invalid.title: The workspace command was rejected
claude_workspace_command_invalid.description: The command tool received an unsupported request. No command was accepted through this tool.
claude_workspace_command_invalid.recovery: Check the agent task and command tool arguments. Inspect existing activity before starting a replacement run.

claude_mediation_outcome_unknown.title: The GitHub operation outcome is unknown
claude_mediation_outcome_unknown.description: The host lost the response to an authorized GitHub operation. The remote change may have completed.
claude_mediation_outcome_unknown.recovery: Inspect the GitHub target and its operation journal before submitting another operation. Do not retry the write blindly.

unsupported_join_provider.title: This agent cannot use graph tracking
unsupported_join_provider.description: The graph tracking service does not support this runner provider.
unsupported_join_provider.recovery: Use a configured Codex or Claude runner with the matching graph tracking service.

lease_service_required.title: Cleanup supervision is not configured
lease_service_required.description: The runner cannot start work without an independent container cleanup service.
lease_service_required.recovery: Ask the operator to start the documented lease service and configure its state directory before running the graph.

mediated_grant_unavailable.title: The GitHub authorization grant is unavailable
mediated_grant_unavailable.description: The host could not obtain the scoped grant required for a GitHub operation.
mediated_grant_unavailable.recovery: Ask the operator to check the run approval and mediator service. Do not give the agent a GitHub token.

client_request_identity_conflict.title: This request identity belongs to another task
client_request_identity_conflict.description: The saved request ID is already associated with different execution inputs.
client_request_identity_conflict.recovery: Inspect the existing run. Start a new task with a new request ID only after reconciling the earlier execution.

first_slice_requires_fresh_codex.title: Graph tracking requires a supported fresh run
first_slice_requires_fresh_codex.description: This graph tracking entry point accepts only fresh Codex or Claude invocations.
first_slice_requires_fresh_codex.recovery: Select Fresh or Start on the supported agent. Use its Run Reference for status, resume or cancellation.

flow_resolver_required.title: Saved graph lookup is not configured
flow_resolver_required.description: The graph tracking service has no saved-flow resolver.
flow_resolver_required.recovery: Ask the operator to configure saved-flow lookup in the graph tracking service.

invalid_langflow_start.title: The graph start request is incomplete
invalid_langflow_start.description: Graph tracking could not validate the task and execution identifiers.
invalid_langflow_start.recovery: Save the graph and start it from the graph Run control. Inspect any earlier run before submitting another task.

runner_ack_identity_mismatch.title: The runner acknowledgement does not match
runner_ack_identity_mismatch.description: The runner returned identifiers that could not be correlated with this graph invocation. The task may have started.
runner_ack_identity_mismatch.recovery: Inspect the runner and graph tracking records before submitting another start.

runner_cancel_identity_mismatch.title: Cancellation could not be matched to the run
runner_cancel_identity_mismatch.description: The active runner binding does not match the requested graph invocation.
runner_cancel_identity_mismatch.recovery: Inspect the Run Reference and runner activity before attempting cancellation again.

runner_lookup_mismatch.title: The recovered run does not match
runner_lookup_mismatch.description: The runner lookup returned a different provider, request or execution identity.
runner_lookup_mismatch.recovery: Ask the operator to reconcile the saved request with the runner journal. Do not submit another start blindly.

runner_lookup_unknown.title: The runner execution could not be located
runner_lookup_unknown.description: The read-only lookup did not establish which execution belongs to this request.
runner_lookup_unknown.recovery: Inspect the runner journal and existing activity. The request may still be active; do not repeat it blindly.

runner_observation_not_correlated.title: The activity record does not match the run
runner_observation_not_correlated.description: The runner observation could not be attached to the expected graph invocation.
runner_observation_not_correlated.recovery: Inspect the Run Reference and graph tracking records before changing or repeating the task.

runner_request_not_frozen.title: The original start request was not recorded
runner_request_not_frozen.description: The tracking service has no frozen request identity for this invocation.
runner_request_not_frozen.recovery: Inspect the graph tracking records and any native activity before starting a replacement task.

runner_start_unknown.title: The runner start outcome is unknown
runner_start_unknown.description: The start response was lost or could not be verified. A native execution may already exist.
runner_start_unknown.recovery: Use the saved request identity to inspect runner activity before submitting another start.

saved_flow_identity_mismatch.title: The saved graph does not match
saved_flow_identity_mismatch.description: The tracking service could not verify the requested saved-flow identity.
saved_flow_identity_mismatch.recovery: Save the intended graph and check the graph tracking configuration before starting it.

stage_not_in_saved_flow.title: The agent is absent from the saved graph
stage_not_in_saved_flow.description: This agent node could not be found in the saved-flow revision used for tracking.
stage_not_in_saved_flow.recovery: Save the graph with this agent node, then inspect earlier execution state before starting a new task.

unresolved_component_identity.title: The saved node definition is incomplete
unresolved_component_identity.description: The tracking service could not freeze a unique node ID and component definition.
unresolved_component_identity.recovery: Save or reload the graph and ensure its custom components are installed before starting a new task.

unresolved_saved_graph.title: The saved graph is incomplete
unresolved_saved_graph.description: The tracking service could not read a nonempty saved node list.
unresolved_saved_graph.recovery: Save the graph and check that the graph tracking service can retrieve it.

completed_origin_required.title: The source agent has not completed
completed_origin_required.description: Handoff requires a completed Origin Run.
completed_origin_required.recovery: Connect a completed agent Run Reference to Origin Run before passing its output onward.

handoff_provider_required.title: The source agent provider is missing
handoff_provider_required.description: The Origin Run does not identify a supported provider.
handoff_provider_required.recovery: Connect an explicit Codex, Claude or OpenCode Run Reference to Origin Run.

handoff_task_required.title: The handoff task is empty
handoff_task_required.description: Neither Task Override nor the completed source answer supplies a task.
handoff_task_required.recovery: Provide Task Override in Advanced or use a source run with a nonempty answer.

one_to_sixteen_targets_required.title: The controller target list is invalid
one_to_sixteen_targets_required.description: A controller needs between one and sixteen agent targets.
one_to_sixteen_targets_required.recovery: Set Targets to a supported nonempty list.

provider_model_effort_required.title: A controller target is incomplete
provider_model_effort_required.description: Each target must specify a supported provider, model and effort.
provider_model_effort_required.recovery: Configure each target with Codex, Claude or OpenCode and a valid model/effort pair.

explicit_stop_and_mode_required.title: The controller stop condition is missing
explicit_stop_and_mode_required.description: The controller requires an explicit stop condition and execution mode.
explicit_stop_and_mode_required.recovery: Set Mode and Stop When before starting the controller.

artifact_path_list_required.title: The selected artifact paths are invalid
artifact_path_list_required.description: The controller could not validate the artifact path list.
artifact_path_list_required.recovery: Provide a list of relative artifact paths in the controller settings.

claude_native_skill_policy_unsupported.title: The selected skill needs unsupported controller permissions
claude_native_skill_policy_unsupported.description: This skill contains controller-side shell substitutions or metadata that can change the frozen tool, model or session grant. It was refused before execution.
claude_native_skill_policy_unsupported.recovery: Use a pinned skill without inline shell substitutions, hooks, fork contexts or tool/model overrides. Run permitted draft scripts through the isolated workspace command tool instead.

fresh_codex_request_required.title: A new agent run is required
fresh_codex_request_required.description: This handoff route accepts only Fresh operations targeting Codex or Claude.
fresh_codex_request_required.recovery: Choose Fresh and a supported target agent. Resume must use that agent’s original completed Run Reference.

runner_token_file_required.title: The handoff runner is not connected
runner_token_file_required.description: The host has not configured an authentication token file for this provider.
runner_token_file_required.recovery: Configure the provider runner token file on the host, then check its Status. Never put the token in a graph.

runner_token_unavailable.title: The handoff runner login is unavailable
runner_token_unavailable.description: The host could not read the configured runner token file.
runner_token_unavailable.recovery: Restore access to the configured host token file and check Status before submitting work.

runner_token_invalid.title: The handoff runner login is invalid
runner_token_invalid.description: The configured host token does not match the runner token format.
runner_token_invalid.recovery: Configure the original token file created by this runner. Do not paste or edit tokens in the graph.

dispatch_stopped.title: The handoff was stopped
dispatch_stopped.description: Stop was requested before this handoff finished dispatching.
dispatch_stopped.recovery: Check the source and target run Status to reconcile any accepted work before starting another run.

runner_request_conflict.title: The handoff request conflicts with saved work
runner_request_conflict.description: The request identity is already bound to different work.
runner_request_conflict.recovery: Inspect the saved run and handoff. Do not reuse its request identity for a changed payload.

invalid_runner_response.title: The handoff response could not be verified
invalid_runner_response.description: The runner did not return a usable run reference. Remote execution may still be active.
invalid_runner_response.recovery: Check the target runner Status and retained request before dispatching again.

invalid_runner_status_identity.title: The handoff status belongs to different work
invalid_runner_status_identity.description: The returned status did not match the expected provider and run identity.
invalid_runner_status_identity.recovery: Check the configured provider endpoint and original Run Reference. Reconcile existing work before a new dispatch.

foreign_resume.title: This agent cannot resume the selected session
foreign_resume.description: The native session belongs to another provider.
foreign_resume.recovery: Resume through its original provider, or use an explicit Fresh handoff with selected artifacts.

runner_request_changed.title: The handoff request changed during dispatch
runner_request_changed.description: The request no longer matches its frozen identity or contents.
runner_request_changed.recovery: Restore the frozen request and inspect the existing run before issuing different work.

runner_result_pending.title: The handoff result is still pending
runner_result_pending.description: The graph did not observe a terminal result within its waiting deadline. Execution may still be active.
runner_result_pending.recovery: Check Status or request Cancel for the existing run. Do not start a duplicate while its outcome is unknown.

runner_poll_identity_mismatch.title: The handoff status could not be matched
runner_poll_identity_mismatch.description: A status response did not match the acknowledged target run.
runner_poll_identity_mismatch.recovery: Verify the provider endpoint and saved Run Reference, then reconcile that run before dispatching again.

activity_attempt_identity_required.title: Activity could not bind to this attempt
activity_attempt_identity_required.description: The runner acknowledgement did not include a valid activity-attempt identity. Work may already have been accepted.
activity_attempt_identity_required.recovery: Inspect the existing run before starting another request. Share the safe technical details with the maintainer to repair the acknowledgement path.

activity_attempt_identity_mismatch.title: Activity belongs to a different attempt
activity_attempt_identity_mismatch.description: The returned activity does not match the accepted execution attempt. It was not attached to this invocation.
activity_attempt_identity_mismatch.recovery: Keep the original Run Reference and inspect that attempt. Do not substitute events from a neighbouring run.

activity_runner_identity_mismatch.title: The activity run could not be matched
activity_runner_identity_mismatch.description: The activity endpoint returned a different run identity.
activity_runner_identity_mismatch.recovery: Verify the configured runner and original Run Reference before continuing.

activity_runner_token_missing.title: Activity cannot connect to the runner
activity_runner_token_missing.description: The host runner token file is empty.
activity_runner_token_missing.recovery: Configure the original runner API token file on the host. Never put it in the graph.

agent_activity_binding_conflict.title: Activity is already bound to different work
agent_activity_binding_conflict.description: The saved invocation cannot be attached to a different runner identity.
agent_activity_binding_conflict.recovery: Inspect the retained invocation and its original Run Reference before starting replacement work.

agent_activity_closed.title: This activity record is already closed
agent_activity_closed.description: New events cannot be appended to a terminal activity record.
agent_activity_closed.recovery: Inspect the retained result. A new execution needs its own invocation identity.

agent_activity_cursor_invalid.title: The activity page could not be selected
agent_activity_cursor_invalid.description: The requested pagination cursor is invalid.
agent_activity_cursor_invalid.recovery: Refresh the Agents tab to reload activity from its saved starting position.

agent_activity_event_invalid.title: An activity event could not be accepted
agent_activity_event_invalid.description: An incoming event did not satisfy the activity contract. It was not recorded as valid evidence.
agent_activity_event_invalid.recovery: Inspect the run Status and retained partial activity. Share the technical code with the maintainer.

agent_activity_execution_required.title: Activity is missing an execution identity
agent_activity_execution_required.description: The graph did not supply the execution identity needed to keep invocation records separate.
agent_activity_execution_required.recovery: Run the saved graph through the application execution path. Share the technical details if the identity is still missing.

agent_activity_identity_required.title: Activity is missing its owner or node identity
agent_activity_identity_required.description: The application could not establish the identity needed to reserve an activity record.
agent_activity_identity_required.recovery: Open the saved graph in the signed-in application and share the technical details if the problem remains.

agent_activity_not_found.title: This activity record is unavailable
agent_activity_not_found.description: No accessible activity record matches this request.
agent_activity_not_found.recovery: Refresh the Agents tab and select an invocation available to the current application account.

agent_activity_status_invalid.title: The activity status could not be accepted
agent_activity_status_invalid.description: The supplied status is not supported by the activity contract.
agent_activity_status_invalid.recovery: Inspect the existing run Status and share this technical code with the maintainer.

claude_host_login_unavailable.title: The local Claude login could not be read
claude_host_login_unavailable.description: The runner could not read the selected host Claude access credential.
claude_host_login_unavailable.recovery: Check that Claude Code is signed in on this machine and that its local credential file is available to the app.

claude_host_login_expired.title: The copied Claude access credential needs refreshing
claude_host_login_expired.description: The host credential file contains an access credential that is expired or about to expire.
claude_host_login_expired.recovery: Use your signed-in host Claude session to refresh its credential, then start the task when it is ready. The runner does not refresh a duplicate login.

claude_local_login_copy_failed.title: The local Claude login could not be copied
claude_local_login_copy_failed.description: The app could not update the dedicated local runner profile. No host profile or sessions were copied.
claude_local_login_copy_failed.recovery: Check local Docker access and the dedicated runner volume. Host credentials are only copied to a verified local Docker endpoint.
